ma.showActionSheet(Object object)

Display action menus.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
alertText String No Warning text.
itemList Array Yes Text array of a button. The maximum array length is 6.
itemColor String #000000 No Text color of a button.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.success Callback Function

Parameter

Object res

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String showActionSheet: ok.
tapIndex Number Sequence number of the button clicked by the user, starting from 0 from top to bottom.

Sample Code

ma.showActionSheet({
  itemList: ['A', 'B', 'C'],
  success(res) {
    console.log(res.tapIndex);
  },
  fail(res) {
    console.log(res.errMsg);
  }
});
